name: Grid-based Traversal
aliases: Hierarchical grid traversal for irregular volumes
definition: A method using a hierarchical data structure for rectilinear grids to quickly determine tetrahedra possibly hit by traversed grid cells, enabling interactive rendering of irregular volume data.
summary: Grid-based Traversal renders irregular volumes by partitioning data into a hierarchical grid to find candidate tetrahedra, distinguishing itself by avoiding explicit connectivity information and relying on spatial hashing.
